RBI proposes new measures to curb banking fraud

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has proposed a 'trusted-person' facility and an 'instant debit freeze' mechanism to combat banking fraud. The 'trusted-person' facility would allow customers to designate trusted individuals for high-value transactions, while the 'instant debit freeze' or 'stop switch' aims to block all outgoing payments. Other proposed measures include transaction limits and digital payment controls.
